html.fix.remove: Move the credential out of these files, for example into your hosting provider's secrets, and then change it at the provider. Do it by hand: do not ask an agent to handle the key.
html.fix.rotate.step1: Create a new key at the provider, update the apps and services that use it, and revoke the old one. Removing it from git does not revoke it.
html.fix.rotate.step2: Once you have revoked it, record it with the button (paste the instructions into your agent) or by hand. RosmarOps cannot check the revocation: it will be recorded as declared by you.
html.fix.rotate.step3: On the next run, RosmarOps will ask whether you made that change. Confirm only if you did.

html.gloss.agent.a: An AI program that works on your computer with your permissions: it reads files, runs commands and edits code. Claude Code, Cursor and Cline are agents.
html.gloss.auto.a: A Claude Code mode in which it asks you much less: reads and edits inside the project are approved on their own, and most other actions are decided by another AI model. Since version 2.1.283 it is the mode Claude Code starts in unless you choose another.
html.gloss.config.a: The file where an agent lists the extra tools it starts when it opens (MCP servers). Whoever can write to it can make the agent run a new program.
html.gloss.env.a: A file where a project keeps its keys and passwords so it can run. It usually stays out of git, but it is still on your disk, and any program that can read your files can read it.
html.gloss.master.a: The Supabase key meant only for servers (service_role): it bypasses all the security rules of your database. It should not be on your computer unless it is essential.
html.gloss.score.a: It starts at 100 and drops with each warning, more for the serious ones and for the ones reachable from more places. With any urgent warning it never goes above 49; with only warnings to review, never above 79. The method is public.
html.gloss.settings.a: Claude Code's settings file for your user. It decides what Claude Code can do without asking you.
